replacements.Un release gate decide con evidencia, no: A release gate decides from evidence, not checked boxes
replacements.Cada frontera aporta un artefacto verifi: Each boundary contributes a verifiable artifact. Break one piece of evidence and watch the route change: the gate diverts the release to HOLD instead of letting it reach production.
replacements.Flujo de evidencia hacia una decisión de: Evidence flow into a release decision
replacements.Tres evidencias independientes alimentan: Three independent evidence streams feed the gate. Invalid evidence breaks its path and diverts the decision to HOLD; only three valid streams allow DEPLOY.
replacements.La evidencia rota no se compensa con dos: Broken evidence is not offset by two green checks: it changes the effective release topology. The production route disappears and an explicit HOLD route appears.
replacements.El gate puede reconstruir qué se verific: The gate can reconstruct what was verified and allow the release because all three boundaries provide current evidence.
replacements.La decisión está ligada a evidencia repr: The decision is bound to reproducible evidence from the threat model.
replacements.La policy o sus scopes ya no corresponde: The policy or its scopes no longer match the release candidate. Two healthy evidence streams do not restore authority.
replacements.La evidencia de autorización no coincide: Authorization evidence does not match the deployable contract.
replacements.Revalidar policy, usuario, recurso y ope: Revalidate policy, user, resource and operation before deployment.
replacements.El schema o la procedencia de memoria di: The schema or memory provenance differs from the approved baseline. The release is no longer reproducible.
replacements.El estado alcanzable ya no coincide con: Reachable state no longer matches the evaluated baseline.
replacements.Reconciliar schemas, scopes y procedenci: Reconcile schemas, scopes and provenance, then rerun the regression.
replacements.El sistema puede bloquear ataques, pero: The system may block attacks, but there is no current evidence for the kill path and rollback.
replacements.No hay prueba reproducible de detención: There is no reproducible stop-and-recovery test.
replacements.Ejecutar kill switch y rollback end-to-e: Run the kill switch and rollback end to end before release.
